items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are mostly clear and constants are named (MagicByte1, NonceSize). Exported API (Encryptor, DecryptReader, Config, LoadKey) has no doc comments. The UnmarshalYAML raw struct uses cryptic fields like `KeySourceSnk`/`KeyEnvVarKeb`, and the decrypt state machine has almost no comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: LoadKey is about 85 lines, and the env/file/literal branches copy the same base64-decode plus `len(key) != KeySize` check. The unrequested UnmarshalYAML alias handling adds weight. The split into config.go and encryption.go is otherwise clean.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Chunk lengths are bounds-checked, the HMAC uses hmac.Equal, Close is idempotent and closers are ordered correctly. But several errors use `%v` instead of `%w` ("truncated stream: %v"), so the error chain is lost, and EncryptWriter calls `panic(err)` on cipher setup.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The required signature changes are made and callers are updated. storage.PathGenerator keeps its old signature by passing `false`. Unencrypted output is unchanged. Unrequested extras: UnmarshalYAML accepts new alias YAML keys (key_source, key-env-var...), plus exported WithEncryption and new exported constants.
